gaps.note: The MX5/MX10/MX40/MX80 hardware guide says two things about the one management jack. Its Routing Engine description gives one 1-Gbps Ethernet port for the management network; its ETHERNET port pinout section calls the same jack an autosensing 10/100-Mbps RJ-45 receptacle. Neither is carried. The EXT CLK A and B jacks are the two BITS clock inputs the same description lists, so they are `rj48`.

ground-stud-pitch.note: the hardware guide, grounding points specifications: 0.625-in. (15.86-mm) centres, which is 5/8 in., 15.875; the guide rounds the conversion. `ground-studs` is one placement of juniper/mx-ground-stud-pair-5-8@1, which composes juniper/mx-ground-stud@1 twice at exactly 15.875 (L116) and presents `stud-pair-5-8`, so one two-hole lug (generic/two-hole-lug-5-8@1) lands across the pair and the ring lug still lands on either stud, `ground-studs/1` and `/2`. The two studs were drawn 14.0 apart; they moved symmetrically about the midpoint the photograph placed, (394.75, 19.75), one stud above the other, so the host is placed at `rotate: 90` and a lug's wire leaves downward, and their cutouts with them.

ground-stud-size.note: the hardware guide, grounding points specifications: two threaded holes that fit SAE 10-32 screws, spaced at 0.625 in. (15.86 mm) centres, for one two-hole cable lug: the `stud-size` of both studs.

power.note: guide power consumption topics - Table 14 (AC) and Table 20 (DC) give the modular chassis "running at high activity, with four 10-Gigabit Ethernet XFPs, two MICs, and fans running at high speed" 310 W on both feeds, which the guide's own worked examples call typical power consumption; carried as power-typical-w, OUTPUT side. Table 14 adds the AC INPUT figure at 85% efficiency, 365 W (the family datasheet's "typical power draw (AC)" for the MX80-MX5 is the same 365 W, its DC 310 W); without the two MICs the base is 240 W output, 282 W input. Tables 13 and 19 give the fixed MX80 (not modelled) 320 W. Table 11's 610 W AC system input power and Table 17's 625 W DC system input (13 A at -48 VDC) are provisioning ratings, not draw, and are not carried. Table 32's maximum thermal output, 1705 BTU/hour (500 W), is one supply's maximum output (Table 12, 500 W) times 3.41 - a provisioning ceiling, carried under thermal and flagged so. The guide gives modules only a generalized 35 W per MIC (Table 15) and points at the MX Series Interface Module Reference; 13 of the 14 modules this chassis accepts carry a figure on their contracts, and the fan tray, which no table here rates, is the one L29 reports
